parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/CPUSessionAggregatorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the two test methods `contextTransitionStartsNewSession` (line 186) and `sameContextTransitionDoesNothing` (line 265) share a Jaccard similarity of ~0.73, they are intentionally distinct test cases exercising complementary behaviours of `CPUSessionAggregator`: one asserts that a context transition starts a new session, the other asserts that an identical context transition is a no-op. Collapsing or extracting them would obscure the distinct failure signals each test is designed to surface.
